name: Greedy-based Box Packing
definition: A volume rendering pre-processing method that partitions a volume into variably-sized bounding boxes based on alpha values and packs these boxes into 2D texture slices to bypass 3D texture padding waste.
summary: Greedy-based Box Packing partitions 3D volumes into bounding boxes based on alpha values and packs them into 2D slices to avoid 3D texture padding waste.
